subject: Insurance
title: Benjamin Franklin's Insurance Legacy
description: One-minute skill: Benjamin Franklin's Insurance Legacy.

hook.text: Benjamin Franklin co-founded America's first insurance company in 1752.

buildup.text: Franklin saw London's fire insurance model and brought it to Philadelphia.

discovery.text: Franklin's company refused to insure houses with trees nearby.

twist.text: Rejected homeowners formed their own company—the Green Tree. Competition drove better coverage and lower prices.

climax.text: Franklin proved that insurance works in America. His company inspired hundreds more across the new nation.

punchline.text: No trees near the house. Franklin's fire rules launched American insurance.

quiz.question: Why did Franklin's insurance company reject some homes?
